page.layout: One column of verse at the top, with a running head above it; below, a rule and the title of the Carmen in large capitals, then a verse column of the same width.

l.i: Vnius in prolis conceptum currere messes
Iusserunt magna cum ratione decem.
Scilicet haud aliter prorsus quā pluribus annis
Formari tantus debuit ipse puer.
Et (si fas homini res est aperire futuras,
Nec dici Sanum numen inane decet)
Quo deni plures ternis sunt noctibus anni,
Hoc tuus ipse infans Herculē maior erit.
ECce nouos peperit Gallis Catharina triūphos
Iam prole dives altera:
Natorumque loco, felicem crescere turbam
Auus nepotum conspicit.
En, Sinduṁ nata, in cunis Isabella videtur
Vagire quiddam Regium.
Moxque iocos blanda tenero cum fratre sororis
Spectabit Henricus pater.
At Gallus primis iam nunc miratur in annis
Suos futuros principes.
Et quamuis tenera, magnum ia frontis honorem
Notasque regias colit:
Donec, paulatim illorum crescentibus annis,
Spes Gallia adolescat simul:
Francisco ut domitos fortis, victosque pudico.

page.notes: The single slash mark above the title is an ornament and is not transcribed. The verse is set as couplets, the second line of each indented. "Sinduṁ" and "ia" as printed in the scan are uncertain: the first line of the fifth couplet reads "En, Sinduṁ" in the scan's spelling, and "ia frontis" may be "in frontis". Final word "pudico" is read from the scan.
